protection_panel.subtitle: Saved protection checks and current availability.
protection_panel.sign_in_explanation: Sign in with your PIN, then choose Start test.
protection_panel.start_explanation: Start when you are ready to lock the screen or put the device to sleep.
protection_panel.android_policy: Tokenlogue locks in the background. Enter your app PIN to return. Device recovery depends on the device screen lock. Desktop screen lock and sleep tests are unavailable on Android.
